meta.title: Current Buyer Brief Folio
meta.standfirst: Generated from the current buyer.md brief. Domain live search pages blocked the fresh pull, so this folio ranks the latest stored Domain inventory against today’s brief and flags freshness caveats.

brief.region: Within ~20 minutes' drive of the Sydney CBD. Open across the inner-south (currently live in Zetland and like it), the eastern suburbs, the lower north shore, and the inner-west as far out as Marrickville. Not interested in the outer/greater western suburbs.
must_haves: Within roughly 20 minutes drive of CBD

market.standfirst: Fresh Domain search was blocked at source today; treat this as a ranked buyer-agent fallback report, not a complete market scrape.
market.overview: The system attempted a clean scratch run across Zetland, Bondi Junction, Randwick, Crows Nest, North Sydney and Marrickville, plus sold comparables. Domain returned block/challenge pages for every live search. The shortlist below uses the latest stored Domain data already in the local database, scored with the current buyer.md brief and the latest decision engine.

forces.label: Freshness
forces.body: Live Domain search pages did not expose structured listing data during this run. Verify active status before contacting agents.

forces.label: Brief fit
forces.body: Scoring, risk checks, valuation logic and action planning were run against the current buyer.md owner-occupier purchase brief.

forces.label: Use case
forces.body: Good enough for shortlist review and inspection planning; not enough for offer pricing without a refreshed listing page and contract/strata review.

market.outlook: The right next move is to use this as a ranked fallback shortlist, then re-run the live scrape once Domain’s browser gate clears or manually open the top listing pages for current status and inspection times.

properties.description:
Positioned within Victoria Park's sought-after 'Elite' development, this stylish apartment combines contemporary design, quality finishes and peaceful parkland views in a low-maintenance setting. Offering a well-designed single-level layout with two generous bedrooms, it presents an excellent opportunity for professionals, investors or those seeking an effortless urban lifestyle, less than 5km from Sydney CBD. Perfectly located, the residence sits moments from East Village Shopping Centre, popular cafés and dining, with Green Square Station just a short walk away.

What's important to you
- Light-filled interiors with fresh finishes and sleek flooring throughout
- Seamless single-level layout flowing onto a covered entertainer's balcony
- Two bedrooms with built-ins, main featuring ensuite
- Contemporary stone kitchen with gas cooking and quality appliances
- Stylish main bathroom plus a separate internal laundry for added convenience
- Air-conditioning, intercom access, lift entry and secure car space
- Well-maintained complex offering an indoor pool and fully equipped gym

The local's point of view
- Next door to East Village's shopping, and dining out experiences
- Opposite Joynton Park, ideal for relaxing or walking the dog
- Less than 1km strolling distance to Green Square station
- A range of vibrant local cafés and bars in the neighbourhood
- Within 600m to the Gunyama Park Aquatic and Recreation Centre
- A great base for commuting to Sydney Airport or the CBD

properties.description:
On level three of the landmark 'Yalara', this bright two-bedroom apartment captivates with its leafy sea glimpses through every window. Spacious and lightly refreshed interiors ensure comfort, with the apartment extending to a balcony taking in the idyllic surrounds. Enjoy access to onsite leisure facilities and peaceful gardens, with the building also offering the convenience of lift access. Adjoining Fred Hollows Reserve, this well-placed complex is located partway between Coogee Beach and Randwick Village making a superb investment or a convenient home base. Just a short walk to great schools, the hospital precinct, Royal Randwick Shopping Centre, light rail, The Spot and cafes.

	Each room enjoys a tranquil vista with sea and district views
	Living area extends to a covered balcony set in the trees
	Well-presented separate kitchen with brand new cooktop
	Two large bedrooms, one complete with built-in wardrobe
	Refreshed bathroom with bath and elegant brass tapware
	Lush security entrance on Dutruc St with intercom and lift
	Leisure facilities include a sunny pool, sauna and BBQ area
	Internal laundry, secure basement car space plus store cage

Disclaimer: All information contained herein is gathered from sources we believe reliable. We have no reason to doubt its accuracy, however we cannot guarantee it. All interested parties should make and rely upon their own enquiries.

properties.description:
Luxury finishes and a sense of scale underpin the appeal of this elevated apartment that rests within stunning 'Symphony'. Over-sized spaces include flowing living zones, a luxury kitchen, enormous bedrooms and a green fringed balcony.

What's important to you
- Prime corner position in the block with an impressive 104 sqm on title
- Contemporary flooring, high ceilings, spacious living and dining room
- Luxury stone and gas kitchen with a large island bench/breakfast bar
- Walls of glass flood the interiors with light and open out to the balcony
- Two immense bedrooms with robes, master with a hotel-like ensuite
- Concealed study nook, ducted a/c, European laundry, storage cage
- Single secure car space, building manager, pool, gym, spa and sauna

The local's point of view
- Meriton built 'Symphony includes CCTV security and a rooftop BBQ
- Set behind the Gunyama Sports Field and close to the aquatic centre
- Stroll to close by dog friendly Joynton Park and Mary O'Brien Park
- Level walk to Green Square's lifestyle hub including Woolworths
- Nearby East Village and Zetland's 'eat street' will be a favourite
- Stroll to multiple bus services, just 1km to Green Square Station
- It's minutes to Moore Park Golf, Centennial Park and the SCG

Enjoying a blissful back of block setting and embracing a lush garden outlook, this superb apartment provides a spacious contemporary haven with a clever design, resort amenities and easy convenience. 

What's important to you
- First floor position overlooking the manicured green central gardens
- Bright fresh interiors, high ceilings, engineered floors, reverse cycle a/c
- Spacious living and dining with a floor to ceiling bank of glass sliders
- Generous covered balcony with a garden outlook, stone gas kitchen
- Quality appliances, dishwasher, storage cupboards, main bath/laundry
- Built-in robes, master with study nook and ensuite, security car space
- Resort style complex features a lagoon pool, barbeque area and spa

The local's point of view
- Enjoy green living metres to Mary O'Brien Reserve and Tote Park
- East Village & Zetland's 'eat street' are steps away & will be a favourite
- The world-class facilities of Gunyama aquatic centre are close by
- It's an easy walk to multiple bus services and Green Square Station
